DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Bronchitis.

I have reviewed your history and the sputum description. Given the 11-year duration of productive cough, morning predominance, and recurrent exacerbations requiring antibiotics, the clinical picture strongly supports chronic bronchitis. I will not pursue further tests as the diagnosis is established by your symptoms and history.
